'''Darth Val''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. By [[3630 BBY]] she was wanted by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] for slander, inciting violence, terrorism and murder. Her wanted poster was displayed in the [[Overwatch]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Val appears during '''Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' on a wanted holo-poster.
